title: W11169652 — Load test: detergent pump (fn 010)
description: Enter service mode and activate the detergent dosing pump for live verification.

steps.title: Console control panel?
steps.body: Console models use membrane buttons and a seven-segment display. LCD-in-door models use the TOOLS menu and touchscreen — answer No for those.

steps.title: Console — enter Service Diagnostic mode
steps.body: Washer in standby. Enter Service Diagnostic mode (3-button sequence × 3 rounds) until display shows 888.

steps.title: Console — activate detergent pump (function 010)
steps.body: Press the 2nd diagnostic button (display shows 001). Use Soil/Temp to select function 010 (Detergent Pump). Press START — display flashes 010 while the pump runs. Press POWER to turn off when finished.
steps.sourceExcerpt: 010 — Detergent Pump — Turns on the detergent pump.

steps.title: LCD — enter Service Diagnostic mode
steps.body: Enter DIAGNOSTICS HOME via TOOLS → INFO → SERVICE & SUPPORT (password 123 × 3).

steps.title: LCD — toggle Detergent Pump ON
steps.body: Scroll to Component Activation. Turn Detergent Pump ON — confirm pump runs. Toggle OFF when finished. Activate only one load at a time.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Turn Detergent Pump On — confirm voltage measurement.
